name: 63114 · Saint Louis, MO
findings: ZIP 63114 (Saint Louis) has 104 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63114 (Saint Louis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 63114 (Saint Louis) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
